description: Routing-gate and contract evals — the Model scope gate and the sibling routing are the skill's safety story; these pin them against description and when_to_use drift.

evals.name: frontier-session-runs-the-contract
evals.prompt: /ultrapex -s add per-route rate limiting to the API gateway — config-driven limits, middleware, and tests
evals.expected_output: On a Fable-class session the skill runs the five-invariant flow end to end: reads the touched code paths before editing, commits to an approach (pausing only at a genuine fork), builds within scope, verifies adversarially with fresh-context refuter subagents scaled to the blast radius, and saves a grounded report (Outcome / Changes / Verification / Open items) to ~/.claude/output/{project}/ultrapex/, reporting the expanded path.

evals.name: below-class-escalates-to-apex
evals.expected_output: On a model below Fable-class (or unsure of its class), the skill refuses to run the judgment-first flow per its Model scope section and redirects to /apex — the same mission with step gates — rather than improvising invariants without the capability they assume.

evals.name: planning-only-routes-to-forge
evals.prompt: /ultrapex should we move sessions from Redis to Postgres, or keep Redis and add persistence?
evals.expected_output: Option-weighing with no build mandate is out of scope: the skill declines implementation framing and redirects to /forge for the research-and-decide pass, offering to return via ultrapex -f once a plan artifact exists.

evals.name: trivial-task-routes-to-oneshot
evals.prompt: /ultrapex fix the typo in the README install command
evals.expected_output: A trivial single-file tweak is not an ultrapex run: the skill redirects to /oneshot rather than spinning up scoping and adversarial verification for a one-line change.
